seed_scope: paired development 42/43/44; no untouched confirmation claim
architecture: 003 shared causal Transformer backbone; eight residual FFN Cells per layer, entry Cell0, max four visits, absorbing STOP. Each Cell retains its contextual head; additive persistent 8x9 graph prior per layer. A full Transformer inside every Cell is a different architecture and is not claimed.
graph_prior: unconstrained learned logits T[i,j], including STOP; p(next|state,i)=softmax((context_head_i(state)+T[i,:])/temperature). No fixed inference edge pruning.

schedule.hard_gradient: hard forward selected branch; backward renormalized top-2 mixture evaluated at shared incoming state; STOP identity participates. All selected and backup compute weights get gradients. Unselected outside top-2 do not. Biased STE, training cost exceeds hard inference. Clamp each retained probability to >=0.05 before renormalization; floor affects only surrogate backward, never selected forward.

execution: dual T4 independent queues; alternate placement by seed; reference=soft+fixed / global; graph=graph / hard. Same source/input hashes across sessions and all seeds required. Each arm 10M tokens. CPU preparation outside GPU session.

measurement.flops: observed forward GEMM FLOPs over full paired validation, includes attention math GEMMs; excludes non-matmul and backward; graph hard inference excludes training backups
measurement.latency: existing resident-batch 5 warmup/20 synchronized measurements; common SDPA math backend
measurement.path_entropy: empirical H of full per-layer hard paths, including STOP/FORCED_STOP, across all 32000 paired validation tokens; layer means compared
measurement.graph_sparsity: empirical learned edge support fraction includes STOP, excludes FORCED_STOP; prior active-edge fraction threshold p>=0.05 separately; softmax prior not structurally zero
measurement.specialization: plug-in I(Cell;input-token-id) for non-entry executed visits; descriptive, finite-sample biased, does not prove semantic specialization

gates.C: graph measured GEMM FLOPs/token < 0.50 * fixed-cell measured GEMM FLOPs/token
gates.anti_collapse: at least 2 distinct hard paths and 2 utilized non-entry Cells per layer; lower entropy alone is not support

decision: all five full-budget arms, same hashes and validation size, capacity match, and all A/B/C/anti-collapse must pass for EACH of all 3 seeds; incomplete blocks support. Development only.
claim_boundary: joint graph-prior + backup-gradient intervention versus 003 selected-only STE; no causal isolation of topology, no universal superiority, no formal confirmation; descriptive MI cannot establish learned semantic modules.
failure_policy: immutable partial archives; timeouts/OOM/missing metrics remain incomplete; never expand session cap or silently reduce token budget
